card.name: Lead-in remarks just before a list or table
card.fires_on: Words or punctuation right after a sentence that introduces a list, map or table, such as "refer" in "the numbers refer to", "Note", or the colon after "Editor's note". It looks ahead to a list that follows.

modes.label: Editor's note colon
modes.description: The colon or punctuation after a short note label at the start of an article.
modes.example: Editor’s Note<<:>> David Wise is the author of numerous books
